content:
"Orange" is famously known as one of the hardest words in English to rhyme with — there are no perfect rhymes for it in standard English. However, here are some options:

## Near (Slant) Rhymes
- Hinge
- Cringe
- Binge
- Fringe
- Singe
- Tinge
- Lozenge
- Syringe
- Scavenge
- Challenge
- Porridge
- Forage
- Storage
- Door hinge
- Door fringe

## Creative/Forced Rhymes
- **"Blorenge"** – a hill in Wales (one of the only true rhymes!)
- **"Sporange"** – a rare botanical term for a spore case (technically a perfect rhyme)
- **"Door-hinge"** – used by rapper Eminem in a clever multi-syllable rhyme

## Multi-word Rhymes (popular with poets and rappers)
- "More inch"
- "Four-inch"
- "Pour in"
- "Foreign G"

Eminem famously claimed he could rhyme "orange" by stretching syllables: *"I put my orange four-inch door hinge in storage and ate porridge with George."*

Would you like help using any of these in a poem or rap verse?
